shortDescription: Russia's second-largest lender VTB RUS:VTBR on Friday said that its July net profit had risen 73.4% year-on-year to 40.4 billion roubles ($469.77 million).The bank reaffirmed its 2026 profit target of 600 billion roubles.($1 = 86.0000 roubles)
